current_official_run: Uses the previously frozen independent /tmp client. No live-run file, journal or database was modified by this work. Failed timing/unfinished evidence remains a failure.
algorithm_changes: Rebuild per-work operation ID, applied external revision and pending reservation-by-order indices from fresh durable rows.
Seed completeness performs one stable SHA256 per seed and Map lookups, avoiding a SHA256 per candidate operation; seed statuses are reread, never permanently latched true.
Immutable catalog/source/config/seed definitions are loaded only after startup or resume validation; mutable context/status/result data stays fresh after awaits.
The 50ms source scheduler decodes only the selected due events; lightweight SQLite context/ID/status/EXISTS readers replace repeated full operation/config JSON parsing.
Completed receipt/order stages skip payload construction only if all corresponding stages are done; prior reservation supersession remains before the order skip.
8-hour task eligibility uses one fresh shift context per work selection; milestone reads exclude the large immutable baseline config.

explicit_scheduling_changes.processor: Independent 50ms eligibility pulse, at most one in-flight processor per company; no source batch-completion gate.
explicit_scheduling_changes.old_scheduler: One mixed ordinal due list, first20, batch Promise.all gate; pending result polls could delay new event transmissions.
explicit_scheduling_changes.resume: Exact scheduler version is required before connection/enqueue; old runs must use their original frozen client.
explicit_scheduling_changes.latency: Request start through full response body and JSON decoding, including client event-loop waiting; response headers alone do not end measurement.

additional_quality_evidence.normal_external_window_assignment: Canonical planned offset, not late actual transmission time.
additional_quality_evidence.peak_backlog: Immutable pre-peak-end event identity cohort stored at peak end900000ms; received server backlog and unsent source backlog are distinguished. Deadline1500000ms.
additional_quality_evidence.normal_peak_reporting: Before/peak/after and combined normal p95, sample counts, actual outcomes and failures; existing whole-window fields remain.
additional_quality_evidence.expected_rejections: At startup only planned order.update event IDs permit business_rejected USE_CANCELLATION/CREATE_LINKED_ORDER with fixed owner/follow-up. Exact policy is persisted and recomputed on resume; other reasons/types/technical/quarantine are not exempted.
additional_quality_evidence.unapplied_quantity: Each expected rejected revision exposes its original result and line delta versus the preceding successfully applied source plan; no automatic addition/cancellation is performed.
additional_quality_evidence.final_verdict: Existing whole-window quality and the new normal/peak-cohort quality must both pass for a full profile; smoke remains unqualified.

validation.reason: Root full npm run verify passed; subsequent simulator-only wrapper guards passed the complete 55-test simulator suite. Actual fault/profile tests remain pending.

simulator_unit_suite.regression: Lifecycle final_reconciliation.status stays unverified, HTTP403/503 is separately retained in http_status; original expected lifecycle status is unchanged.

bounded_failure_recovery.main_control: 5xx/network503/429 use durable attempts/next_at and Retry-After (seconds or date); max6 consecutive failures. Permanent403 etc stop gracefully. Invalidated snapshots cannot start new physical commands. Source lanes and original request IDs are unchanged.
bounded_failure_recovery.deadline: Checked independently of retry eligibility before and after awaits; in-flight control HTTP requests use the remaining deadline budget.
bounded_failure_recovery.final_reads: Snapshot and each exact boundary/cursor ledger request retry at most3 attempts within60000ms; unavailable final data yields unverified failed JSON, never stale-snapshot success.
bounded_failure_recovery.shutdown: Normal, exceptional and finally paths share memoized source/physical/process settlement before report/journal closure; settlement failures are recorded.
bounded_failure_recovery.preparation: Without measured_start, report has not_started, null measurement clocks and unverified integrity. Preparation is never a measured25min interval.
bounded_failure_recovery.report_writes: Journal failure report is durable; JSON uses temporary file+rename. Filesystem failure emits PROFILE_REPORT_WRITE_FAILED stderr and exits nonzero; filesystem success cannot be guaranteed.
bounded_failure_recovery.accounting: Failed HTTP attempts remain in api_call observations and total/normal technical numerator and denominator.
bounded_failure_recovery.resume: Exact recovery_version required in run.config; counters survive resume.
bounded_failure_recovery.shift_coordinator: Null boundary, unverified raw final data or not-started measurement produce failed/unverified shift summaries with no extra reconciliation HTTP; independent final-read exceptions are also preserved as failed summary evidence.
bounded_failure_recovery.preflight_scope: Connection/catalog preflight before journal creation remains outside the post-start retry controller. Proxy tests target the first main/seed read after journal creation.
bounded_failure_recovery.http_status_separation: final_reconciliation.status is a lifecycle string, and final_reconciliation.http_status is the separate HTTP integer; errorEvidence remains a nested HTTP failure shape elsewhere.
